scope: Full-portfolio Opus calibration of every claude-skills library skill not already covered by SKILL-CALIBRATION-OPUS-SAMPLE-LATEST.json (which holds audit, readme-drift-sync, skill-usage).
methodology: Same A/B methodology as the Sonnet runs. Arm A: Opus sub-agent solves the task cold, no SKILL.md access. Arm B: Opus sub-agent reads d:/koodaamista/claude-skills/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and follows it. Token usage from harness's per-sub-agent usage.total_tokens — input + output + cache_creation; cache_read excluded.

task_briefs.ai-codegen-smell-audit: Audit Spacepotatis src/ for AI-codegen smell patterns. Findings with severity tags and file:line citations.
task_briefs.mikko-audit-suite: Plan which mikko-* audits to run on mikkonumminen.dev and in what order. Index document only.
task_briefs.mikko-help: List installed mikko-* skills at ~/.claude/skills/ with descriptions. Markdown summary.
task_briefs.mikko-install: Plan installing all mikko-* skills from claude-skills/skills/ to ~/.claude/skills/. Plan only.
task_briefs.security-audit: Security audit of Spacepotatis src/. Findings with severity tags and file:line citations.
task_briefs.session-cost: Compute the token cost of session 47fcb7d8-762b-45af-ae2a-b9e4af3c295b. Main thread + sub-agents breakdown.
task_briefs.skill-calibration: Plan an A/B calibration for a hypothetical /example-skill in AudiobookMaker. Plan only.

skills.name: ai-codegen-smell-audit
skills.notes: Re-dispatched 2026-05-26 after both arms session-limit failed. Save rate 47% on Opus vs Sonnet's 48% — strikingly consistent across models. Largest absolute save in claude-skills. Arm A explored 10 candidate findings vs arm B's 1 (the structured Opus arm A is more permissive); arm B's stricter inclusion criteria save tokens while raising precision.

skills.name: mikko-help
skills.notes: Skill encodes a source-repo cross-check — extra work for completeness, costs more than just listing installed skills. Same direction as Sonnet.

skills.name: mikko-install
skills.notes: Near-break-even on Opus vs Sonnet's -35%. Opus narrows the cost-more dramatically — recipe's protocol overhead matters less when the cold arm already does the right thing.

skills.name: react-anti-patterns-audit
skills.notes: Target had no React; both arms correctly returned no findings. Arm B's structured pre-flight + abort cost more than arm A's quick check. Negative-result target — positive-result repos would likely differ.

skills.name: security-audit
skills.notes: Re-dispatched 2026-05-26 after both arms session-limit failed. Same direction as Sonnet (-4%) but slightly more cost-more on Opus. Arm B was an Opus orchestrator collapsing the multi-phase audit; the recipe encodes thoroughness (Critical/High/Medium/Low + Info severity walk + standing-audit context) which both arms now hit, so the recipe overhead exceeds the focus benefit. Skill's value is completeness, not token compression — model-invariant pattern.

skills.name: session-cost
skills.notes: Methodology note: Opus arm A's output included cache_read_input_tokens (returned a 554M total) — that's the BASELINE Opus behavior the skill is designed to prevent. The SKILL.md explicitly excludes cache_read because those tokens were paid upstream. Arm B followed the recipe and reported 14.15M, which is the correct number for downstream comparisons. Token SPEND on the two arms is comparable (33K vs 32K), so the +4% pct_saved understates the recipe's value here: it's a correctness win (preventing a counting error a cold model defaults into), not a compression win.

skills.name: skill-calibration
skills.notes: FLIPPED from -74% (Sonnet) to +13% (Opus). Opus arm A sketched a more rigorous plan cold (~42K) so the recipe's value is preserved; on Sonnet arm A was too sparse to be comparable.

caveats: Now complete — ai-codegen-smell-audit and security-audit re-dispatched 2026-05-26 after the original both-arms session-limit failures.

Opus and Sonnet land within 2 points (13% vs 11%) on the complete 8-skill set. The +47% save on ai-codegen-smell-audit dominates and the -10% security-audit cost-more partially offsets — same shape on both models.

Cross-portfolio observation: complete-portfolio Opus tracks complete-portfolio Sonnet much more closely than the original 6-skill SAMPLE suggested. The SAMPLE's -3% (vs Sonnet -21%) was a stratified-sample artifact.
